title: Situation Update: what manual operations will cost

fields.headline: Manual operations: two operators per shift, sight gauges, no meter reads
fields.deliverTo: Incident Commander, Water Quality Manager, Customer Service Lead
fields.narration: Ray Castellano sets out what islanding and manual operations will cost. Two operators per shift for as long as the control network stays islanded means call-ins from all three crews tonight and OHWARN if it runs past Wednesday. Grab samples go to every two hours on ERP-3; Hilltop Tank and Northgate Reservoir are read by sight gauge and float board; meter reads stop with MBW-AMI-01.
keyFacts: The plant can run in manual for 72 hours with two operators per shift (ERP Section 8)
OHWARN can supply certified operators within 12 hours
AMI meters store 45 days of interval data
Grab samples every 2 hours on ERP-3
fields.expectedAction: The IC decides staffing (call-ins and an OHWARN standby request) and records it on ERP-1; the Water Quality Manager sets the ERP-3 schedule; Customer Service confirms billing can wait and that no disconnections run while billing is down.
fields.facilitatorNote: Play Ray as reluctant but practical. If the players have not islanded yet, he asks why they would put him through this for a City Hall problem.
fields.scenarioTitle: Ransomware Riptide — Ransomware at City Hall and the Island Decision

instructorNote: Friction: the cost of the safe choice. Watch for a concrete staffing plan rather than “we’ll manage”.

snapshot.title: Manual Mode Initiation — PLC-02 Chemical Feed Override

fields.headline: Manual Mode Activated — Chemical Feed Override
fields.narration: The Plant Superintendent, Ray, stands at the control room console. 'Control, I’ve confirmed the override on PLC-02 — the hypochlorite feed pump is still running at 100% stroke and 100% speed. No setpoint is active. The session from Kessler-Remote-01 on MBW-EWS-01 has not been terminated. The SCADA / IT Security Manager confirms the jump host was compromised via an unpatched vulnerability. I’m initiating manual mode per Section 7.4. The operator will now take the feed pumps offline and begin manual chemical feed checks using the dose tables from MDWS-SCADA-APP-A, Section 8.4. The lab is down, but we’ll rely on historical data and operator judgment to maintain disinfection. The Water Quality Manager must be notified immediately.
keyFacts: PLC-02 hypochlorite feed pump remains at 100% stroke and 100% speed
Override was not initiated by a local operator
Jump host (MBW-JUMP-01) compromised via unpatched vulnerability
Water Quality Manager must be notified for manual sampling
fields.expectedAction: Ops must authorize the manual operation of the plant per SOP 7.4; confirm that the Water Quality Manager is notified and that sampling will begin immediately using manual logs.
fields.facilitatorNote: Read with urgency. Emphasize that manual mode has been activated and that the lab is offline — this is a critical operational shift.
fields.scenarioTitle: Ransomware Riptide — SCADA Isolation & Public Trust

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms the transition to manual operations. The technical team must now validate that all manual procedures are initiated and that the Water Quality Manager is actively engaged in verification. Watch for any delay in authorizing manual mode or failing to assign a sampling lead.
